name: Monthly Goods and Services Tax return
legal_reference: Goods and Services Tax Act of Bhutan 2020, s. 105 of the definitions — the tax period is a calendar month, or another period the rules prescribe; s. 38 — a taxable person files a GST return no later than thirty days after the end of each tax period; s. 42 — the person self-assesses the GST and files; s. 44 — the net amount is the output tax, less the input tax credits, plus or minus adjustments; s. 46 — a positive net amount is paid when the return is filed. The return form is filed on RAMIS and was not readable from the machine this pack was written on: the rows below are this pack's own, grouped under those figures, and the gap is recorded in this pack's README.

deadline.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, s. 38 — no later than thirty days after the end of the tax period. Thirty days after a month's end falls on the 30th of the next month for every month but January (2 March, or 1 March in a leap year); the pack carries day 30 and the difference is recorded in its README. The late-filing penalty is not modelled.

boxes.name: Zero-rated supplies — exports and international transport
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, Schedule V, paragraphs 2, 9 and 12 — the value of goods exported, of services supplied to customers outside Bhutan and of international transport. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Exempt supplies (Schedule IV)
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, Schedule IV — the value of exempt supplies. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Standard-rated supplies — value
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, ss. 16, 17 and 25 and Schedule I — the sales on which output tax is charged. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Output tax on standard-rated supplies
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, ss. 14(1), 44(1) — output tax on standard-rated supplies, net of credit notes given.

boxes.name: Imported B2B services — value
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, ss. 14(3) and 18 — the value of an imported business-to-business service on which the purchaser is liable. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Output tax on imported B2B services
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, ss. 14(3) and 33 — the tax the purchaser declares as output tax; its credit is in box 2R.

boxes.name: Total output tax
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, s. 44(1) — total output tax: standard-rated supplies plus the reverse-charged imported services.

boxes.name: Standard-rated local purchases — value
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, s. 32 — the purchases on which input tax is incurred. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Input tax on local purchases
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, ss. 32 and 44(2) — input tax credit on local purchases, net of credits received.

boxes.name: Imports of goods — value
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, ss. 12 and 14(2) — the value of taxable imports on which GST is paid at customs clearance. A reporting row of this pack.

boxes.name: Input tax on imports
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, ss. 32 and 47 — input tax credit on GST paid at customs clearance.

boxes.name: Input tax on imported B2B services
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, s. 33 — the customer is allowed an input tax credit for the imported B2B service provided it has accounted for the output tax.

boxes.name: Total input tax
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, s. 44(2) — total input tax credit: local purchases, imports and imported B2B services.

boxes.name: Net GST payable or repayable
boxes.legal_reference: GST Act of Bhutan 2020, s. 44 — output tax less input tax credit. A negative figure is a credit carried or refunded as the Act provides.
